title: NIST WebBook: Ethanol gas-phase standard enthalpy of formation
summary: The WebBook lists 1 gas-phase standard enthalpy of formation row(s) for Ethanol. Reviewed rows and experimental rows are both quoted.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook gas-phase standard enthalpy of formation rows for Ethanol (CAS 64-17-5) print: -234. ± 2. kJ/mol, method AVG, reference N/A, comment: Average of 9 values; Individual data points (calculated or reviewed row). The page mixes reviewed or averaged rows with rows tied to a named experiment or compilation. A Review or AVG method is an evaluation. A Ccb method is combustion calorimetry, as the WebBook method code is linked. This card does not average the rows into a new number.
